title: Black Classical Music
studio_context: His debut solo album (Brownswood / Nonesuch, 8 September 2023), 19 tracks; UK Jazz & Blues chart number 1; Ivor Novello Award for Best Album (2024).

drum_performances.name: Yussef Dayes
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The fullest statement of his vocabulary: linear jungle-ish grooves (Black Classical Music, The Light), reggae (Pon di Plaza, Jamaican Links), Afro-Cuban (Afro Cubanism), 8th-note triplets (Turquoise Galaxy) and the one-footed kick triplet of Tioga Pass.

notable_moments.description: Tioga Pass: three 16ths on the kick on 3, 3e, 3& with one foot, a buzz on the 'and' of 4.
Pon di Plaza: rim clicks on dotted 8ths under 16th hats.
